instruction: I am updating a presentation in LibreOffice Impress. The slide numbers are difficult to see against the background. Please change the slide number color to yellow for better visibility?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing slide number color to yellow in LibreOffice Impress. The evaluator checks if slide numbers in the master slide have yellow color formatting by examining the slideMaster1.xml file for srgbClr elements with yellow RGB values (red > 200, green > 200, blue < 100).

llm_judge_reasons: Overly broad state extraction: The metric searches for ANY yellow color element (a:solidFill//a:srgbClr) in the entire slideMaster1.xml, not specifically the slide number field

Missing specific targeting: Does not identify or verify the slide number placeholder specifically (e.g., <p:ph type="sldNum"/>). Will return true if any shape/object in the master slide has yellow color
False positive risk: If there's a yellow rectangle, yellow background, or any other yellow element in the master slide, the evaluator will pass even if slide numbers remain unchanged
Semantic verification failure: Cannot reliably verify that the instruction requirement (slide number color changed to yellow) was actually completed
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Modify the metric to first locate the slide number placeholder element by searching for elements with p:ph type="sldNum" or p:ph type="dt" attributes
Once the slide number placeholder is identified, traverse its parent/ancestor elements to find the associated color properties (a:solidFill/a:srgbClr)
Only check the color of the specific slide number element, not all color elements in the slide master
Consider checking multiple master slides if the presentation has more than one master slide layout
